versions.changelog:
Technical SEO audit initial release.

- Provides a comprehensive technical SEO audit covering 9 categories: crawlability, indexability, security, URL structure, mobile optimization, Core Web Vitals, structured data, JavaScript rendering, and IndexNow protocol.
- Includes up-to-date guidance on AI crawler management, Googlebot fetch limits, project Mariner fetchers, and AI-specific robots.txt tokens.
- Highlights 2025–2026 requirements such as enforcement against back-button hijacking and updated Google documentation URLs.
- Fully aligns with current Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS); omits outdated FID metrics.
- Details modern security header checks and advanced robots.txt recommendations for both search and AI.
